_why: Price-event queue for master rows that carry a period US ticker but no committed snapshot: FORMERLY US-LISTED (DELISTED/ACQUIRED) issuers (including the six rows resolved from primary SEC text in v16 - Warner-Lambert NYSE:WLA x4 and Roberts Nasdaq NMS:RPCX x2) plus any still-US-LISTED row missed by the two existing jobs. NON-US-LISTING-ONLY rows are excluded on purpose: their recorded symbol is a foreign-line symbol and the Yahoo exchange suffix has not been verified in this repository, so queueing them would risk a wrong-issuer price. Delisted symbols often fail; failures are recorded in the manifest and never retried with a successor ticker.
